# eScience Corporation

> eScience Corporation ("Architects of Innovation") is a Philippines-based provider of Mobile CRM, Inventory Management, and Point-of-Sale (POS) solutions, empowering businesses with real-time retail and enterprise technology since 2000.

eScience Corporation builds mobile-first software for field sales, inventory tracking, and point-of-sale operations, primarily serving retail and distribution businesses in the Philippines. The company is headquartered at Madrigal Business Park, Muntinlupa City, Metro Manila.
